name: D.S. i.F. -Dal Segno- in Future
source:
During the winter, Atsuya and his friends received an invitation letter from the island’s manager Ame, who was supposed to have disappeared.

“Let’s meet again at the village where snow falls and the fireflies fly”

Travelling to the snow-bound onsen town where the ‘snow fireflies’ are said to dwell, they were greeted by the new manager Kanade, along with fireflies dancing about in the falling snow. It was actually an event organized by the Amakase Research Institute to thank them for taking good care of Ame and the fireflies are actually man-made fairies.

Then, the true fireflies actually appeared during the night with a full moon. In the midst of the fantastic scene, Ame reappeared before them once more. Is it another artifical event or is it a miracle for this night only?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/04/01/april-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
冬天，敦也和他的朋友们收到了一封来自岛上管理员阿梅的邀请信，而阿梅本应失踪了。

“让我们在雪花飞舞的村庄再相见吧”

前往据说有“雪萤”居住的白雪皑皑的温泉小镇，新任店长奏迎接了他们，萤火虫在飘落的雪花中翩翩起舞。这其实是天濑研究所为了感谢他们对天濑的照顾而举办的活动，而萤火虫其实是人造的精灵。

然后，真正的萤火虫竟然在月圆之夜出现了。就在这奇异的场景中，阿梅再次出现在了他们的面前。这是另一个人为事件还是只是今晚的奇迹？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/04/01/april-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
